clue.text: French mediator causes noisy quarrel

parts.note: ACAS is the UK's Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, which mediates in industrial disputes

explanation.surface: A French go-between ends up provoking a loud row instead of settling it.
explanation.walkthrough: ACAS is the British body that steps in to settle disputes between employers and unions.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a fracas is a noisy disturbance or brawl.

clue.text: Charge way over the odds for woollen coat

definitions.meaning: to overcharge or swindle someone out of money
the woolly covering of a sheep, or a soft warm jacket

explanation.surface: Someone is overcharged for a wool overcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: swindling a customer, and a sheep's wool covering.

clue.text: Malicious remark made by a small individual crossing island

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

indicators.note: the individual is said to straddle the island, so its letters go around it

parts.note: an individual is a person
I is the map abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A petty person on an island makes a spiteful comment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crossing' puts I inside PERSON to give PERSION, after A and S.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: an aspersion is a damaging, disparaging remark about someone.

clue.text: As in medicines raved over

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the concealed letters are read bottom to top, backwards
the answer lies inside the clue words that follow, so in signals a concealed run of letters

explanation.surface: Seems to compare something to medicines that someone raved about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As in' reads like a phrase, but As is the definition: the chemical symbol of the element. 'in' signals the hidden letters and 'over' reverses them: medicines raved backwards is DEVARSENICIDEM.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the chemical symbol for the poisonous element number 33.

clue.text: Uninformed, I admit, about small number

indicators.note: the verb's letters go round the abbreviation, so about signals one piece enclosing another

parts.note: to grant a point is to admit it
NO is the short form of number, small showing it is abbreviated

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to lacking knowledge about a modest figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: ignorant means lacking knowledge or information.

clue.text: Sculpted idol found in tomb — curious enigma

parts.note: a grave is a tomb

indicators.note: curious, meaning odd or strange, tells us the letters of enigma are rearranged

explanation.surface: An archaeologist finds a carved idol in a tomb, a curious puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curious' rearranges ENIGMA into NIMAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Biblical phrase: a carved figure worshipped as a god, as forbidden in the Ten Commandments.

clue.text: Performing male only seen inside one

indicators.note: the male-only word sits inside the number word, so inside signals insertion

parts.note: a stag event, such as a stag party, is for men only

explanation.surface: A single man is seen within a group of one.
explanation.walkthrough: A stag party is the British name for a men-only celebration before a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: someone appearing in front of an audience in a theatre is performing.

clue.text: Behave badly in performance at university

parts.note: an act is a performance
being up means being in residence at university, in British usage

explanation.surface: A student misbehaves during a show on campus.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain you go up to university and are 'up' while studying there.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb: to misbehave or show off, or of a machine to malfunction.

clue.text: Generate changes in youth, perhaps

indicators.note: changes tells us the letters of Generate are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Something creates transformations in young people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges GENERATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a young person, a youth, may be thirteen to nineteen years old, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Former model in show

parts.note: EX means former, as in ex-wife
to model is to pose for an artist

explanation.surface: An ex-model appears in a fashion show.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as verbs: to expose something is to reveal or show it.

clue.text: Tape of extraordinary test case

indicators.note: extraordinary, meaning out of the ordinary, tells us the letters of test case are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A recording made of a remarkable legal test case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extraordinary' rearranges TESTCASE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a plastic case holding magnetic tape for audio or video recording.

clue.text: Appalling, the French journal

parts.note: chronic is informal British for very bad or appalling
LE is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a French newspaper as dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a chronicle is a record of events, like a journal; also a newspaper name.

clue.text: Principal to leave car in public place in Manhattan

parts.note: central means main or principal
to park is to leave a car standing

explanation.surface: A head teacher is told to leave the car somewhere public in Manhattan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Principal' looks like a head teacher but is the adjective meaning main.
explanation.definitionFit: Central Park is the famous large public park in the middle of Manhattan, New York.

clue.text: Greek character's record covered by Norwegian band

definitions.note: the 's is short for 'is', linking the letter to the wordplay

indicators.note: the band's name wraps around the record, so covered by means insertion

parts.note: a-ha is the Norwegian pop group famous for Take On Me
an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A Greek musician's album is covered by a Norwegian band.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's on 'character' stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The first letter of the Greek alphabet, corresponding to A.

clue.text: Behind bars having committed swindle, judge being uncharitable

indicators.note: the prison word has the swindle committed to it, placed within it

parts.note: inside is slang for in prison
a con is a swindle
to rate is to judge or assess

explanation.surface: A jailed fraudster is judged harshly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'committed' plays on sending someone to prison, but here it means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: inconsiderate means thoughtless of others, lacking charity.

clue.text: Boy band's leader on record

definitions.meaning: the man whose ragtime band gives the title to Irving Berlin's 1911 hit song

explanation.surface: The frontman of a boy band appears on a recording.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boy band' reads as one phrase, but Boy is a definition of its own. The second part refers to the song 'Alexander's Ragtime Band'.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's name, and the bandleader named in Irving Berlin's famous ragtime song title.

clue.text: Mean to eat with the Italian towards the end of the day?

definitions.text: towards the end of the day?

indicators.note: the stingy word takes in the other letters as though eating them

parts.note: tight means stingy or mean
IL is Italian for the

explanation.surface: A stingy diner takes an Italian meal late in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by description rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Dusk, the dim light after sunset, comes as daytime draws to a close.

clue.text: Royal residence listed crown as lost

indicators.note: lost, as in confused or gone astray, tells us the letters of the phrase are jumbled

explanation.surface: The crown, listed in the royal inventory, has gone missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' rearranges LISTEDCROWNAS.
explanation.definitionFit: The castle in Berkshire, England, is one of the monarch's official homes.

clue.text: Caretaker getting wind up over omission

indicators.note: in a down clue the first word sits over, above, the second

parts.note: to wind up something is to bring it to a stop
a gap is an omission

explanation.surface: A janitor gets annoyed over something left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Caretaker' is used in its temporary sense, as in a caretaker government.
explanation.definitionFit: A temporary substitute: a caretaker manager is a stopgap until a permanent one arrives.

clue.text: Touching time with rep around noon

indicators.note: the representative's letters go round the abbreviation, so around signals enclosure

parts.note: a rep or representative is an agent
N for noon, as on a clock

explanation.surface: A moving moment spent with a sales rep at midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts N inside AGENT to give ANGENT, after T.
explanation.definitionFit: Geometry: a tangent line touches a curve at a single point without crossing it.

clue.text: Tempestuous tale involving maiden

indicators.note: the tale takes in the maiden, so involving signals one piece placed inside another

parts.note: a story is a tale
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A passionate story featuring a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' puts M inside STORY.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: stormy and tempestuous both describe wild weather or turbulent emotion.

clue.text: Left donkey attached to old rope

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A donkey was left tied to an old rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso is a rope with a running noose used to catch cattle.

clue.text: Beginning to skid on inadequate track

indicators.note: the beginning of skid is its first letter

parts.note: poor means inadequate

explanation.surface: A vehicle starts to slide on a badly maintained road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'track' looks like a road surface but means an animal's trail.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoor is the track or droppings left by a wild animal, followed by hunters.

clue.text: We, with initial manoeuvring, remain hidden while preparing to attack

definitions.text: remain hidden while preparing to attack

indicators.note: manoeuvring, moving things about, tells us the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Troops, with an opening manoeuvre, stay concealed ahead of an assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvring' rearranges WEINITIAL; 'with' just joins the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: to hide in ambush, waiting for the moment to strike.

clue.text: Former Soviet, say, backing one probing agency

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation is reversed

parts.note: EG, for example, is signalled by say

indicators.note: the numeral probes into the agency word, so probing signals insertion

parts.note: an organ is an agency or means of action, as in an organ of government
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A former Soviet spy is examining an intelligence agency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns EG into GE; 'probing' puts I into ORGAN to give ORGIAN. 'say' belongs to the wordplay, not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Georgia was a Soviet republic, so a native of it is an example of a former Soviet citizen.

clue.text: Editorial guide

definitions.meaning: a newspaper's opinion column, written by its editor
one who shows the way or heads a group

explanation.surface: An editorial serves as a guide.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a newspaper's leading article, and a person who heads or directs others.

clue.text: Make dive the American way

parts.note: to turn is to make or perform, as in turn a profit
a pike is a diving position with the body bent at the hips

explanation.surface: An instruction to perform a dive in the American style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the American way' looks like a manner of diving but is the definition: a road in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: In the USA, a toll motorway or highway is called by this name.

clue.text: Well-built bouncer finally included in investigation

indicators.note: the final letter is placed within the investigation word

parts.note: a study is an investigation

indicators.note: finally picks out the final letter of bouncer

explanation.surface: A burly nightclub doorman is drawn into an inquiry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included in' puts R inside STUDY.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: sturdy means strongly built and robust.
